Special Feeder Cattle Sales 2026-2027

Scheduled Mondays October thru February at 10:00 a.m. Scheduled Fridays in March & April
Recommended Vax Program
  • Four-way Virus Vaccine for IBR-PI3-BVD-BRSV
  • 7-way Clostridial + Hemophilus Somnus, Pasteurella
  • Administer all shots in the neck, booster at least 14 days prior to sale, knife cut while still on cows, dehorn prior to weaning
  • Consider a 10 to 1 buyer ratio on calves with 2 rounds of shots that are weaned at least 45 days versus calves that are not
